name: Itsuki Ringo
source:
Itsuki is Taru's best friend, and the voice of reason that tries to keep his relationship at bay. With a calm and casual outlook, he has a bit of a sly edge- but he always manages to pull through for his friends. Itsuki thinks of himself as the big brother- reliable and responsible for his simple-minded friends.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25920]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
